column3: “Descendants” renders seed; set free renders become free.
Membership in the family replaces remaining in the house.
BSB’s “your” at father matches the Textus Receptus (ὑμῶν).
BSB’s “were” matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “are” (ἐστε).
“Illegitimate children” renders born of fornication; only replaces one.
“His native language” renders from his own; “refusing to uphold” renders does not stand.
